sql: SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*37%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '3295315' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%37%%' LIMIT 5
rows: During two years of treatment there was a 26% reduction in total plasma cholesterol, a 43% reduction in low-density lipoprotein cholesterol, plus a simultaneous 37% elevation of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol
